trap.label: verbo + -ing (uso)
trap.wrong: Do you enjoy to build apps? We avoid to waste time.
trap.right: Do you enjoy building apps? We avoid wasting time.
trap.why: Em português “evitar perder tempo” usa infinitivo. Em inglês, avoid, practice, enjoy e finish pedem -ing.

rewrite.prompt: Faça a pergunta com enjoy: “You build apps.”
Reescreva com avoid: “We don’t waste time.”
Reescreva com practice: “We solve problems every day.”
rewrite.answer: We practice solving problems every day.
